notes: Sources are tried top-to-bottom until one yields >=1 valid model. Toggle `enabled` to skip a source. Edit URLs to survive future Anthropic site changes. Types: api (raw JSON if the endpoint ever embeds pricing), jsonld (extract <script type=application/ld+json> blocks first, then scan), html (strip tags + regex scan). This file is copied to $CLAUDE_HOME/tokens/pricing-sources.json on first run of refresh-pricing.sh — edit that copy, not this bundled default.
